_comment: Overhead /dev/video2. Dual xArm: Robot1 image bottom-LEFT true≈(-0.45,-0.35); Robot2 image bottom-RIGHT mirrored about image vertical through table_xy_affine → true≈(-0.55,+0.51). Do NOT use naive (+0.45,-0.35) — affine rotates axes ~90°.

grasp_height_offset_m._comment: Global (all EEs): added to grasp_height_m when object name contains the key. Negative = lower.

grasp_height_offset_by_ee._comment: Extra grasp z offsets applied only when that EE executes Grasp/Place (solver). parallel_gripper uses global only.

place_height_offset_m._comment: When Place destination is a named object matching the key: z = support.grasp_z + offset (stacks accumulate). stand=+0.02 per layer; container=+0.04 above support. Per-arm overrides: execution_by_arm.*.place_height_offset_m

overlap_xy._policy: Mutex: only one arm may be inside overlap during a step. After Grasp, if a later Place of the same object by that arm exists, skip retract (stay at lift) and release the lock so Grasp→Place is direct even with interleaved other-arm steps. After Place (or Grasp with no pending Place), retract to exclusive workspace then release.

xarm2._role: Robot2 LeapHand @ 192.168.2.199. Image bottom-RIGHT = mirror of Robot1 about image vertical; after table_xy_affine (~90°), true-table base ≈ (-0.55,+0.51) NOT (+0.45,-0.35).

robot._comment: Legacy single-arm field (Robot1). Prefer robots{} for multi-arm.

execution._comment: Legacy Robot1-only block. Multi-arm runners should read execution_by_arm.
execution._height_note: Measured 2026-08-08: STOP at grasp → base z≈200 mm. tip_z_base = table_z_base_m + grasp_height_m.

grasp_height_offset_m._comment: arm1 parallel gripper: grasp screw 1cm lower than global.

place_height_offset_m._comment: arm1 parallel gripper: place onto stand +2cm higher than global (0.02→0.04).

xarm2._note: Base≈(-0.548,+0.505) image BR. Same axis convention as xarm: +X≈image-up into table, +Y≈image-left (flip_y=true). flip_y=false made bear hover go image-right/out of FOV.

table_xy_affine._comment: true_table = A @ pred_table + b (metres). pred = global table_xy_affine(raw); per-arm residual.

leaphand._comment: LEAP MCP flat open = π (higher=curl). MCP 1/5 forced to π (no raw offset). Only joint 6 uses measured_open_raw. Open ramps present→π over open_duration_s.

measured_open_raw._comment: Do NOT set 1/5 here (code strips them → π). Joint 6 measured open only.

leaphand._comment_manual_poses: open_leap/close_leap: taught 16-DOF LEAP poses. When both set, open()/close() use them directly (skip formula thumb scales).
